tool_args.rationale: The fresh confirmation error is far above tolerance despite an exact pilot fit. A high-gradient probe directly tests the diagnosed threshold and supplies observations needed to identify a piecewise extension.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits the pilot but was refuted on fresh confirmation, indicating an unobserved regime change.
The pilot does not identify a high-gradient threshold or avalanche strength; acquire the targeted probe before fitting it.
The evidence points to a gradient-regime breakdown rather than an unresolved temporal trajectory.
